ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited reported mixed unaudited standalone and consolidated Q1 FY27 results, with revenue from operations growing approximately 12% year-over-year (YoY). However, net profit after tax experienced a substantial decline of 78-80% YoY, primarily due to faster-growing operational expenses. This significant margin erosion, despite revenue growth, represents a material financial concern, although the auditor's limited review reports contained no modifications.
